draft_text: Mirevant outperforms RookReader in exact-match accuracy on the Norlake-QA test set.
revised_text: Mirevant achieved higher mean exact-match accuracy (74.6%) than RookReader (73.7%) on the Norlake-QA test set, though the paired 95% confidence interval for the mean difference [-0.12, 1.92] includes zero.
rationale: Mean EM: Mirevant 74.6% vs RookReader 73.7% (T1). The paired 95% CI [-0.12, 1.92] includes zero, and no p-value was reported, so "outperforms" (implying a reliable advantage) is not supported. A narrower claim of higher mean accuracy is defensible.
